mainEntity.name: What is the difference between standard and custom pool tile installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Standard pool tile installation typically involves using readily available, mass-produced tiles with limited design options, often focusing on functional rather than aesthetic customization. Custom pool tile installation, however, offers a bespoke approach, allowing for unique designs, specialized materials, and intricate patterns tailored specifically to your vision. This includes personalized color schemes, mosaic art, and high-quality, durable tiles that reflect your individual style. While standard options are more budget-friendly, custom installation provides a distinct, high-end finish that enhances property value and appeal.
acceptedAnswer.description: Standard installation uses mass-produced tiles with limited options. Custom installation offers bespoke designs, specialized materials, and intricate patterns tailored to your vision, enhancing aesthetics and value.
